messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Formatting warnings - recordTable and dectionHistory. And a bug?
parts:
Hi David,

I agree, the console output is messy. Can you please reinstall from github and see if the warnings are better now?

About the possible bug, what version of camtrapR are you using? I'd need to check more carefully with the actual data. Feel free to privately email me a workspace with a little subset of the data, just enough to reproduce the error. I'll have a look then.

Also, please share the function call of detectionHistory. Did you set any other arguments that may potentially affect the survey duration (e.g. maxNumberDays)?

Normally, detectionHistory should of course include records on the retrieval day. In the current CRAN release, it should the 23:59:59 on the retrieval day, as you said. In v2.1 (on github), the user can optionally set the time of camera retrieval (in the camera table that is used by cameraOperation). If it is not provided, the function will assume 12 noon for retrieval (same for setup by the way), so records after noon would be excluded if retrieval time is not defined. But telling from the time of the records that's not the case here since the records are from the morning.

I'll have a closer look if you send me the data.

Best regards,

Jürgen
